crossRefs.note: God said, “Let’s make man in our image, after our likeness. Let them have dominion over the fish of the sea, and over…
God blessed them. God said to them, “Be fruitful, multiply, fill the earth, and subdue it. Have dominion over the fish…
The fear of you and the dread of you will be on every animal of the earth, and on every bird of the sky. Everything…
Jesus came to them and spoke to them, saying, “All authority has been given to me in heaven and on earth.
has at the end of these days spoken to us by his Son, whom he appointed heir of all things, through whom also he made…
Yahweh says to my Lord, “Sit at my right hand, until I make your enemies your footstool for your feet.”
Then the end comes, when he will deliver up the Kingdom to God, even the Father, when he will have abolished all rule…
He put all things in subjection under his feet, and gave him to be head over all things for the assembly,
You have put all things in subjection under his feet.” For in that he subjected all things to him, he left nothing that…
who is at the right hand of God, having gone into heaven, angels and authorities and powers being made subject to him.

translations.web: You make him ruler over the works of your hands. You have put all things under his feet:
translations.bsb: You made him ruler of the works of Your hands; You have placed everything under his feet:
translations.kjv: Thou madest him to have dominion over the works of thy hands; thou hast put all things under his feet:
translations.asv: Thou makest him to have dominion over the works of thy hands; Thou hast put all things under his feet:
